huaqiangbei.name: Huaqiangbei
huaqiangbei.summary: Shenzhen's electronics shopping district, with SEG Plaza, Huaqiang Electronic World and shops for gadgets, accessories and components.
huaqiangbei.summaryZh: 深圳电子产品购物商圈，可逛赛格广场、华强电子世界，以及各类数码产品、配件和电子元器件商店。
huaqiangbei.address: Huaqiangbei Road, between Shennan Road and Hongli Road, Futian District, Shenzhen
huaqiangbei.addressZh: 深圳市福田区华强北路步行街（深南路至红荔路段）
huaqiangbei.transport: Metro Line 1 to Huaqiang Road, followed by a short walk north into the shopping district.
huaqiangbei.transportZh: 乘地铁1号线到华强路站，再向北步行进入华强北商圈。
huaqiangbei.originZh: 深圳大中华喜来登酒店
huaqiangbei.journeyTime: About 15–25 minutes by metro and on foot (estimate)
huaqiangbei.journeyTimeZh: 地铁加步行约15–25分钟（估计）

directions.en: Walk from the hotel to Convention & Exhibition Center metro station and take Line 1 toward Luohu.
directions.zh: 从酒店步行到会展中心地铁站，乘1号线罗湖方向列车。

directions.en: Get off at Huaqiang Road station. Follow signs toward Huaqiangbei Road and walk north into the pedestrian shopping district.
directions.zh: 在华强路站下车，按指示牌前往华强北路，向北步行进入购物步行街。

directions.en: Browse SEG Plaza and Huaqiang Electronic World along the street. Keep the Hotel tab handy for your return trip to BitCity in the hotel complex.
directions.zh: 沿街可逛赛格广场及华强电子世界。之后返回酒店所在的大中华广场逛BitCity时，可查看“Hotel”页中的酒店地址。

huaqiangbei.driverTextZh: 请送我到华强北步行街，靠近赛格广场，在附近可以停车的位置下车。
huaqiangbei.mapQuery: 华强北步行街 赛格广场 深圳市福田区华强北路

bitcity.name: BitCity 次元小镇 — Anime Mall
bitcity.summary: An anime and pop-culture shopping district with collectible figures, themed shops and interactive entertainment. It is in the same Great China complex as your hotel.
bitcity.summaryZh: 以二次元文化、潮玩手办及互动娱乐为特色的购物街区，与酒店同在大中华广场商业体内。
bitcity.address: G level, Great China HUA Plaza, 1 Fuhua 1st Road, Futian District, Shenzhen
bitcity.addressZh: 深圳市福田区福华一路1号，大中华HUA广场G层
bitcity.transport: Walk within the Great China complex; a taxi is not needed from the hotel.
bitcity.transportZh: 从酒店步行前往，同在大中华广场商业体内，无需打车。
bitcity.originZh: 深圳大中华喜来登酒店

directions.en: From the hotel lobby, follow signs or ask the concierge for Great China HUA Plaza / BitCity.
directions.zh: 从酒店大堂出发，按指示牌前往大中华HUA广场／BitCity次元小镇，或请礼宾人员指路。

directions.en: Go to the mall's G level and look for the BitCity 次元小镇 signs. Allow extra time to find the entrance on your first visit.
directions.zh: 前往商场G层，寻找“BitCity次元小镇”的招牌。首次前往时，可多预留一点时间寻找入口。

directions.en: If coming from elsewhere, take Metro Line 1 or 4 to Convention & Exhibition Center and use Exit A toward Great China HUA Plaza.
directions.zh: 如从其他地方出发，可乘地铁1号线或4号线到会展中心站，从A口前往大中华HUA广场。

bitcity.driverTextZh: 请送我到大中华HUA广场的BitCity次元小镇，靠近会展中心地铁站A口。
bitcity.mapQuery: BitCity 次元小镇 大中华HUA广场 深圳市福田区福华一路1号

dongmen.name: Dongmen
dongmen.nameZh: 东门商业步行街（东门老街）
dongmen.summary: Shenzhen's historic shopping district: pedestrian lanes, fashion shops, snacks and lively street performances. A good final stop for browsing and dinner.
dongmen.summaryZh: 深圳历史悠久的购物商圈，有步行街巷、服装店、小吃及热闹的街头表演，适合当天最后逛街和吃晚饭。
dongmen.address: Dongmen Old Street, Luohu District, Shenzhen; near Laojie metro station
dongmen.addressZh: 深圳市罗湖区东门商业步行街，老街地铁站附近
dongmen.transport: Metro Line 1 directly from Convention & Exhibition Center to Laojie; use Exit E for Dongmen Old Street.
dongmen.transportZh: 从会展中心站乘地铁1号线直达老街站，由E口前往东门老街。
dongmen.originZh: 深圳大中华喜来登酒店／BitCity次元小镇
dongmen.journeyTime: About 25–35 minutes by metro and on foot (estimate)
dongmen.journeyTimeZh: 地铁加步行约25–35分钟（估计）

directions.en: From the hotel or BitCity, walk to Convention & Exhibition Center metro station and take Line 1 toward Luohu.
directions.zh: 从酒店或BitCity步行到会展中心地铁站，乘1号线罗湖方向列车。

directions.en: Get off at Laojie station and follow Exit E toward Dongmen Old Street, as recommended by Shenzhen's official visitor guide.
directions.zh: 在老街站下车，按深圳官方旅游指南推荐，从E口前往东门老街。

directions.en: Explore the pedestrian shopping streets and snack stalls. To return, take Line 1 toward Airport East and get off at Convention & Exhibition Center.
directions.zh: 逛步行购物街及小吃摊。返回时乘1号线机场东方向列车，在会展中心站下车。

dongmen.driverTextZh: 请送我到东门老街附近可以停车的位置，靠近老街地铁站E口。
dongmen.mapQuery: 东门商业步行街 老街地铁站E口 深圳市罗湖区
